exclusion_detail: Lead 4o is a 1,3,4-oxadiazole from the pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine hydrazide 18 and an N-substituted lithium isonipecotate 14: acid A3 alone takes 3 steps (acylation of 2-picoline, N-amination/cyclisation, lithiation/CO2), then ester 17, hydrazide 18, N-alkylation 13, hydrolysis 14, POCl3 cyclisation: about 8 reactions.

lead.label: 4o
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 4o was identified as a potent 5-HT4R partial agonist with favorable ADME properties and good in vivo efficacy'.

notes: Experimental procedures are in the SI, which was not supplied; every series member needs more than 4 steps from commercial materials anyway.
